candidates.summary: the 400-page cap aborts the whole preview instead of truncating it, unlike the realm cap beside it in the same claim
candidates.failure_scenario: A PR whose changed realms carry more than 400 renderable pages: per-file $source pages are rendered for every changed file of a changed realm (wantFile, crawl.go:227, returns slices.Contains(changed, name) with no budget), so an examples-wide reformat or gno-version bump over 25 realms reaches it. Crawler.Run then returns `page cap 400 reached (queue still had N)` (crawl.go:126), render() returns that error at main.go:143, `gnopreview render` exits 1. pr-preview.yml's render step has no continue-on-error and the upload step's `if: steps.plan.outputs.skip != 'true'` still carries the implicit success(), so nothing is uploaded: the PR gets a red `preview / render` check and no preview at all. The realm cap in the same sentence of the body degrades instead - BuildPlan truncates and reports plan.Dropped (plan.go:256).
candidates.verify_by: go test -run TestB3PageCapIsFatalNotATruncation -v . in misc/gnopreview with the artifact copied in: Run() over 6 realms with MaxPages=3 returns an error, MaxPages=0 returns nil over 19 pages
candidates.evidence: zz_b3claims_test.go:51: Run() with MaxPages=3 -> error "page cap 3 reached (queue still had 31)", 3 pages captured and discarded by the caller; zz_b3claims_test.go:58: Run() with MaxPages=0 -> nil, 19 pages

candidates.summary: plan.Empty() lets a gnoweb plan with zero realms through, and render indexes plan.Realms[0] unconditionally
candidates.failure_scenario: Plan.Empty() is `!Gnoweb && len(Realms) == 0` (plan.go:91), and the gnoweb seed realms are appended only when `pkgs[r] != nil` (plan.go:265). A gnoweb-only change in a tree where the four seed realms have been renamed, moved out of examples/gno.land, or stripped of their non-test .gno files produces Gnoweb=true with Realms=[], Empty()=false, so render() proceeds and `urlOf(plan.Realms[0])` panics with index out of range instead of reporting "nothing to preview".

candidates.evidence: zz_b3claims_test.go:84: Gnoweb=true Realms=[] Empty()=false Mode()="gnoweb"; zz_b3claims_test.go:94: plan.Realms[0] panics: runtime error: index out of range [0] with length 0

candidates.summary: the comment claims a gnoweb change always gets the fixed four-view sample, but the else-if drops it whenever any realm also changed
candidates.failure_scenario: main.go:153 says "When gnoweb itself changed, a fixed sample of pages shows what the chrome now looks like", and the PR body says a gnoweb change embeds screenshots of the four views. The code is `if len(plan.ChangedRealms) > 0 { pairs } else if plan.Gnoweb { shots }`: a PR touching gnoweb and one realm (Plan.Mode() == "both") takes the first branch, so plan.Shots stays empty and the comment carries no chrome sample - exactly the change where the chrome is what moved.

candidates.summary: the plan is built before the subcommand is validated, so an unknown command pays for the whole examples walk
candidates.failure_scenario: The package doc names two modes, plan and render. run() calls readLines and BuildPlan (a WalkDir over examples/gno.land plus a go/parser pass over every non-test .gno file) before the switch, so `gnopreview typo -changed changed.txt` walks and parses the whole examples tree and only then reports `unknown command "typo"`; a mistyped command in CI also fails with whatever BuildPlan errors on first rather than with the usage line.
candidates.verify_by: time `gnopreview bogus -changed /dev/null` against a full checkout and read the error it prints

candidates.summary: findRoot's doc says it walks up from dir, but an explicit -root is returned unvalidated
candidates.failure_scenario: The comment says findRoot "walks up from dir (or the working directory) until it finds the monorepo root, identified by examples/gnowork.toml". With -root set, the function returns filepath.Abs(dir) without checking for examples/gnowork.toml, so a -root one directory off fails later inside LoadPkgs' WalkDir with a bare ENOENT on examples/gno.land instead of the flag's own message.
candidates.verify_by: run `gnopreview plan -root /tmp -changed /dev/null` and read the error: expect the findRoot message, observe a WalkDir ENOENT

candidates.summary: the gnoweb seeds are appended after the realm cap, so "at most 25 realms" can be 29
candidates.failure_scenario: The body's Scope and bounds says "At most 25 realms and 400 pages". BuildPlan truncates to maxRealms at plan.go:256 and then appends up to four gnowebSeedRealms at plan.go:263-270, so a PR that changes gnoweb and 25+ realms boots gnodev on 29 packages while plan.Dropped reports only the realms the cap removed. The seed append also skips the `Ignore` check that the dependents loop applies (plan.go:241), against the same section's "ignore = true packages" exclusion.
candidates.verify_by: BuildPlan with a changed list of 30 realm files plus gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go and maxRealms 25: count len(plan.Realms)
